Specification of Communication Management
AUTOSAR AP R25-11
• The E2E checks shall be performed for Fire-And-Forget method requests on the
skeleton/server side according to [SWS_CM_10466] and [SWS_CM_10468].
• If the E2E check fails on the skeleton/server side, and an E2E error han-
dler is registered, the registered error handler shall be called according to
[SWS_CM_00034], [SWS_CM_10471] and [SWS_CM_00047].
• There shall be no E2E state machine maintained for the Fire-And-Forget method
on the proxy/client side.
• No E2E error response according to [SWS_CM_10472] shall be sent back to the
proxy/client in case of E2E errors are detected on the skeleton/server side.
⌋
Note:
Figure 7.19, figure 7.20 and figure 7.21 apply to Fire-And-Forget Methods.
